title: Can You Fly a Drone in Tanzania?
excerpt: Flying a drone in Tanzania requires permits, and drones are not allowed in national parks without special permission.
body:
Drone photography is popular, but in Tanzania the rules are strict.

## Permits

Flying a drone requires permission from the Tanzania Civil Aviation Authority and, in many cases, other authorities. The process takes time.

## National parks

Drones are not allowed in national parks or conservation areas without special permission from the park authority. That usually applies to commercial filming.

## Airports

Bringing a drone without the right permits can lead to it being held at the airport.

## Our advice

For most travellers, leaving the drone at home is the best option. The rules are there to protect wildlife and privacy.

## Alternatives

A [balloon flight](/blog/serengeti-balloon-safari/) or a [scenic flight](/blog/fly-in-safari/) gives you views from above.

## Rules change

Check the latest rules with the authorities before you travel.
